resume-builder.title: Resume Builder & Interview GPT
resume-builder.description: Developed a comprehensive resume builder application with AI-powered resume generation using Gemini API. Created well-designed, professional resume templates with user-friendly data input and real-time preview functionality. Built a sister project - Interview GPT - to help users improve interview skills, get DSA preparation guidance, and analyze skill gaps against job requirements.

c-compiler.title: C Compiler & Coding Teaching Platform
c-compiler.description: Designed an interactive coding platform, inspired by Scratch, to teach programming visually. Implemented AST visualization to help users understand how their code is processed. Provided live feedback on user code, helping learners understand syntax, structure, and execution.

sports-fest-site.title: Sports Fest Site
sports-fest-site.description: Designed and developed a fully responsive website for Eklavya '25, the university's annual sports fest. Ensured responsiveness across all screen sizes, optimizing accessibility for participants and viewers. Leveraged Next.js and framer-motion for buttery smooth animations and sleek page transitions.

basketball-scoreboard.title: Basketball Scoreboard & Individual Data Tracker
basketball-scoreboard.description: Built a real-time basketball scoreboard with a focus on speed and ease of use for scorekeepers. Improved UI after 6 months of stress testing, adding undo buttons and repositioning controls for optimal usability. Implemented real-time stats tracking for rebounds and shot accuracy, instantly displaying player performance.

ui-wireframe-generator.title: UI Wireframe Generator
ui-wireframe-generator.description: Explored an existing Self-Attention GAN (SAGAN) model as the baseline for UI wireframe generation. Investigated various attention modules and adopted Cross-Attention, modifying SAGAN to a Cross-Attention GAN (CAGAN) model. Fine-tuned a LLaMA model with segmented images and labeled JSON data to generate JSON outputs from user prompts.

kelp-segmentation.title: Kelp Segmentation
kelp-segmentation.description: Researched current segmentation techniques for satellite images of trees, particularly focusing on Kelp. Built a custom Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) model to filter out noisy images and enhance data quality. Developed a U-Net architecture for image segmentation, achieving a Dice score of 0.55, with the highest score in the competition being 0.73.

dating-parody-app.title: Dating Parody App
dating-parody-app.description: Developed a semi-functional dating app UI in Flutter, matching users based on humorous 'red flags.' Developed the matching algorithm using Python and Firebase, though it remained separate from the UI. Gained hands-on experience with Firebase real-time database operations.

linux-how-to.title: Linux How-To
linux-how-to.description: Compiled comprehensive documentation of essential Linux commands, providing users with a valuable reference. Designed a user-friendly interface that includes tables and Mermaid graphs to visually represent information. Implemented a dynamic workflow that stores information in Markdown files and renders it on the website in real time.

bash-cheatsheet.title: Bash CheatSheet
bash-cheatsheet.description: Compiled comprehensive documentation of essential Bash commands, providing users with a valuable reference. Designed a user-friendly interface that includes tables and Mermaid graphs to visually represent information. Implemented a dynamic workflow that stores information in Markdown files and renders it on the website in real time.

c-vrp-time-window.title: C-VRP with Time Window Constraints
c-vrp-time-window.description: Explored mathematical methods for solving the Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP) with capacity and time window constraints. Utilized the Google Direction Matrix API to incorporate real-world location data into the VRP solution. Employed Google OR Tools and Google Maps API to generate and visualize efficient routes for the given constraints.

weighbridge.title: Weighbridge
weighbridge.description: Collaborated on a project involving the use of Arduino, load cells, and a 16-bit LCD display to measure vehicle weight. Engineered separate platforms for each wheel to enhance precision and accuracy in weight calculations. Demonstrated proficiency in integrating hardware components and applying engineering principles to solve practical problems.
